lines.en: : Heya! I'm guessing you're here to see me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！我猜你是来找我的吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Just can't stay away, can ya?
I spend the night hanging out with Uta in the hall.
lines.zh: 我这一晚都跟 Uta 在走廊上待着。

lines.en: We take a walk around the dorm to kill time and find that there are a number of empty floors directly above us.
lines.zh: 我们绕着宿舍走了一圈打发时间，发现正上方有好几层是空的。

lines.en: I wonder why they stuffed my entire class in here but didn't bother filling up any of the other rooms?
lines.zh: 我纳闷他们干嘛把我们全班塞在这儿，却懒得把别的房间填满？

lines.en: Uta seems to find it strange as well, but we shrug it off and then walk back to her floor together.
lines.zh: Uta 似乎也觉得奇怪，不过我们耸耸肩就算了，然后一起走回她那层。

lines.en: The night ends anticlimactically as Uta decides to head back into her room a little ahead of schedule.
lines.zh: 这一晚结束得毫无高潮——Uta 决定提前一点回房间。

lines.en: She offers to let me join but it seems like her and Io are just going to be watching some TV series they're into.
lines.zh: 她提议我也一起进去，不过看样子她和 Io 只是要追她们在看的剧。

lines.en: Figuring they could use a little alone time, I reject the offer and decide to just visit her again another night...
lines.zh: 想着她们大概需要点独处时间，我拒绝了，决定改天晚上再来看她……
Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]！
